en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dying one, when death presents itself to him, the Angel of death ties him down, and had it not been for that, he would not be calm’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
when a person is about to die, the angel of death ties him down; otherwise, he will not calm down.”
